description: Four-channel stereo mixer in 6HP, with an extra stereo pair that bypasses the level knobs

params.text: Sets the level of that channel in the mix, from silence up through unity to a boost

inputs.text: The left side of that channel, and with nothing patched on the right it feeds both sides in mono
The left side of the auxiliary pair, which goes straight into the mix at unity gain with no level knob
The right side of that channel; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both sides
The right side of the auxiliary pair, which goes straight into the mix at unity gain; with nothing patched here the auxiliary left input feeds both sides

outputs.text: The left side of the mix
The right side of the mix

notes: the four channel gain knobs come up fully down, so only the auxiliary pair, which has no knob, reaches the mix until one is turned up.
